title: An agent outside the department can open that department's task, though its ticket is blocked
date: TAVI 10 Nov 2026 (NDC-Staging, agent "Customer Experience Specialists 2", not in HR) · Zoho Desk trial 10 Nov 2026 + Zoho help

panels.caption: Agent (not in HR): All Activities lists the HR call and task
Agent (not in HR) opens the HR task "QA RT BUG dept task"
Same agent opens the task's HR ticket
Activities are listed per department (switcher in the top bar)
Zoho help: department-based access
text: "Tickets, Knowledge Base, Activities, and Products are department-specific."
"You can view tickets only from those departments that you've access to."
Agents get access per department; the Add Task form has no Department field, the task takes the department chosen in the top bar.

rows.b: Activities list for an agent outside HR
rows.zoho: Only activities of the agent’s departments
rows.tavi: The HR call and task are listed; All Activities shows 527, the same as the owner (tasks 397 both)

rows.b: Open a task of a department the agent is not in
rows.tavi: The HR task opens with department, owner, status, comment box, Start timer and Mark as Complete (API 200; same for the call)

rows.b: Linked ticket card on the task
rows.tavi: Shows only "Ticket" with no number or subject
"Permission denied." toast (the linked ticket call fails)
"This ticket is not available" (403): tickets follow department access, activities do not

notes: The Zoho trial has one agent only, so agent-side visibility in Zoho comes from the help docs, not a screen. Nothing was saved in Zoho.
